provenance: Supplied-context design/candidate reviews, not independent workspace verification. Final sources frozen before native recording. touchedFiles can include concurrent parent edits; recursive tool audit found zero.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 1: bounded probe write and distinct control input
museDesignDisposition.decision: Existing activity deadline bounds send/drain. Tests require fixed probe under4KiB, exact peer acknowledgement and refusal of pending callback before the probe. No approval callback is sent.

No ambiguity in fixed peer: EOF scenarios emit one standalone JSON acknowledgement on stderr and no pulses. Tests compare entire retained stderr bytes to that exact record. No custom ACK syntax needed.

Explicit stdout8192/stderr4096 caps and observed/retained counters. Tests require no overflow for accepted captures; no full-output/postkill-drain claim. Partial final records under cancellation handled as prefixes.
Monotonic activity timing begins after create_subprocess_exec returns. No separate startup latency qualification or500ms requirement adopted.
One waiting writer task and one asyncio.Event, set on EOF or the fixed ready stream. Exact one write asserted. Candidate is fixed-peer tooling, not general packet dispatch.

Uses transport.get_write_buffer_size. Added explicit writerTaskDone observation before final capture; tests require positive queue and unfinished task at multiple increasing-read observations on both streams.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 8-9: cancelled writer reuse and Windows cleanup
museDesignDisposition.decision: Cancellation latches uncertain-write-cancelled, no retry. Activity cancellation settles before local policy close/kill; separate child wait, task settlement and bounded stdin close/abort. No additional data write follows cancellation.

Resolved module directory gives absolute fixed path; validated mode and argv list, -I, no shell. Known peer source is hashed and inspected; no descendants or runtime tree containment claimed. No brittle keyword-only static guard added.
Recorder freezes source/dependency/archive and explicit probe/payload hashes before final launch. Saved --check is in-process hashes/assertions only.
New exclusive output directory, immutable prior cohorts. Documentation limits observations to native Windows termination and fixed peers; no Linux signal claims.
